senses.gloss: m. pl. (פקט to burst forth, ferment) froth, foam (of wine or oil).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 40b:13">B. Mets. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>לוקח … שמרים בלא פ׳</he> a purchaser of oil must accept a Log and a half of lees (to the barrel), but no froth.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 40b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>אחד הלוקח ואחד המפקיד לפ׳</he> the laws concerning foam are the same for the purchaser as for the depositor.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 324:1">Sifré Deut. 324</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 25:6">Is. XXV, 6</cite>) <he>שמרים שאין בהם כלום דבר אלא פ׳</he> lees in which there is nothing but froth (foul matter).
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Esth. R. to I, 3</cite> <he>שמא יתנו שמן פ׳ וכ׳</he> lest they put frothy (rancid) oil in the lamps, opp. <cite ref="Q00516"><he>פטים</he></cite>.
